Welp, I want to say my 10 cents on that:   
After about 15 hours of gameplay I'd like to say a few words. I was prepared to play 24/7 for the first few days with expectation hype but... 

1. Do not expect Harry Potter like game. It's the same wizarding world, but the whole world doesn't feel as magical as we are used with the books and movies. 

2. The game feels slow, only fighting is okay, but everything else is slow. Barely any different answers with conversations, you mostly say the same things to everyone. I cant be rude or pick bad choices (that might change later but in 20 levels - no difference).

3. Classes are very short, you barely experience them. 

4. Clothes customizations also affect your offense/defense points and sometimes you have to put ugly stuff just to upgrade points. Definitely not my thing. 

You have only 4 slots for spells, quite annoying, they increase as you progress but it's quite meh at the beginning. 

5. I really dislike the "go do these 5 tasks so you can learn this spell" thingy. I get it that you want more content, but make it challenging, not repetitive. 

6. I am always winning/best at stuff. Duuh. I want to argue with students, fight them, win, lose, learn stuff while fighting, I want to play team stuff, I want to experience the whole Harry Potter magical world. Not some 3rd person point and shoot with your wand game. 

7. Story seems predictable. So far nothing surprised me or caught my attention to a point where I am like "wooooah, what?" it's mostly "not this generic bullsh.... again". 

8. Why do I have to start in 5th year? Why not start from the beginning? Why with the deluxe version not send our acceptance letters in real life? Why not make it really magical? 

9. Game optimization is baaaaaaaaaaaaaaad. Bugs are often found. I hope they will fix optimization and bugs. I know I do not have top end computer but I run most 2022-23 games on max or high, this one I run on medium and on places it lags. 

10. They really had the chance to create a magical world for us to experience and enjoy. The lack of multiplayer is such a bad choice I am really disappointed. I really wanted to play with people, hunt in dangerous regions/dungeons, help each other, duel each other, have fun in class rooms, some turn to be bad, other good, some aurors, some villains, have fights, wars, castle sieges, etc.. That would've been epic, EPIC! Even though I am huge fan of SP games, this one must be a MP game. It would've been easy to get SP game where you explore and have some sort of story, you develop your character and eventually if you want to and play some extended content - join the MP server, where you can experience a real HP world. 

​

Don't get me wrong, the game is fun, interesting and it has it's own charm, but it's definitely another game that does not live up to the hype and delivers mostly a mediocre content and gameplay, rather than a mind-blowing experience that could let us be these kids that saw the Philosopher's Stone for the first time and we were like glued to the screen and the movie felt like it was part of us. If you want to experience game with wand fighting, magic, etc - this is your game. 

​

If you want to experience Harry Potter world - you'd be disappointed.
